thread:
anya: FYI, noticed a big drop in prefix cache token-saved for redwood-7b in us-west-1 after last night's runtime rollout. per-route hit rate down ~40% on /chat and /complete.

mike: link?

anya: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/cache?orgId=1&panelId=42

anya: promql i used:
```
sum by (model, route) (increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[1h])) /
sum by (model, route) (increase(prefix_cache_lookups_total[1h]))
```

sam: interesting — I saw tokenizer v2 landed in model-variant pipeline yesterday. it normalizes spaces -> could change cache key canonicalization.

jordan: if tokenizer changed whitespace, keys will diverge. we should measure key churn: query to clickhouse:
```
SELECT model, route, countDistinct(key_hash) as distinct_keys, count(*) as lookups
FROM kv_cache_samples
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval 24 hour
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY distinct_keys DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

dinesh: also check `kv_cache_ttl_mismatch` metric — we saw some entries evicted faster after rollout. indexing mismatch could drop hit-rate.

anya: ran a quick sample: top 20 keys now have prefixes with trailing space token changed -> 30% of keys different. attaching snippet.

sam: action: add panel for `token_saved_per_customer` + `key_turnover_rate` and delta vs baseline. I'll own the dashboard delta, will push a PR.

mike: +1. Also we should consider a compat shim in runtime to normalize legacy tokenization for keying for 48h while we roll out.

jordan: I can prototype a key-normalizer feature flag. If we detect old-key-format we map to normalized form before lookup.

dinesh: if we do that, watch memory pressure — mapping increases transient cache lookups. Add a canary for one hostpool.

deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/rollout-2026-03-17 -> us-west-1 pool-3

anya: assign owners & cutover plan: sam (dashboard + alert), jordan (key-normalizer prototype), dinesh (canary + memory guard), mike (decision + rollback if >10% extra latency).

sam: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/456 — adds `Token Saved by customer` panel and `Key Turnover`.

jordan: prototype pushed to branch `key-normalizer-shim`, will link test logs.

anya: will monitor token_saved metric; set alert threshold at 25% drop vs baseline for 30m.

mike: thanks all. sync in eng-runtime standup tomorrow. :thumbsup:
